title: Afterglow
description: A woman in an elegant off-shoulder gown sits barefoot on a blue velvet chaise lounge, holding a lit candle while looking toward an arched window showing a broken icy landscape at sunset. Ghostly faded figures of a man and woman stand behind her in a decaying room with torn wallpaper, scattered playing cards, and empty picture frames.
prompt: A melancholic woman in a cream and gold patterned off-shoulder gown sits barefoot on an ornate blue velvet chaise lounge inside a decaying room with torn floral wallpaper. She holds a single lit candle and looks toward a large arched window revealing a surreal frozen landscape with broken ice and distant mountains at sunset. Two translucent ghostly figures of a couple stand behind her. Scattered playing cards, empty golden picture frames, and a spotlight from above illuminate the scene. Cinematic lighting, realistic painting style.
